summary.text: Susan Witten is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 31 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Tim Hall. Ballotpedia lists her as Susan Tyler Witten.

paragraphs.text: Witten earned a bachelor's degree in business management from Transylvania University in 1992.
Her career experience includes working as a lighting and energy specialist with CED, an account executive with iHeart Media, and a department sales manager with Federated Department Stores.
Witten succeeded Democrat Josie Raymond in District 31.
In the 2025-2026 session she served on the House Local Government, Tourism and Outdoor Recreation (as vice chair), Small Business & Information Technology and House State Government committees.
